title: RAII Handle for a C Lidar SDK
hints: The destructor is just `c_lidar_close(h_);` (the SDK accepts null). Copying must stay deleted, or two handles would close the same device.
Move constructor: steal the pointer and null the source: `h_(std::exchange(o.h_, nullptr))`. Mark it noexcept.
Move assignment: `if (this != &o) { reset(o.release()); }`, which closes what you held first. reset(p) must be a no-op if p == h_.
openAll: push each opened handle into a local std::vector<LidarHandle>. If a later open throws, unwinding destroys the vector, which closes the earlier handles for you.
